package.name: ssa_estimation_v2_cpp
package.description: v2 fork of 3DVehicleDynamicsStateEstimation's ssa_estimation_cpp: same UKF design and state vector, extended with vehicle_model_v2_cpp's physics (dynamic tire radius, longitudinal load transfer, richer force-balance evidence path) and a wheel-speed- difference outlier guard in adaptR. Reuses ssa_estimation_cpp's state_machine.hpp unchanged rather than forking it. See ukf_impl.hpp for the full list of what changed.
